pipeline.modality: Allogeneic SARS-CoV-2-specific cytotoxic T-lymphocyte (CTL) cell therapy

indications.indication: COVID-19 in high-risk / immunocompromised patients (incl. B-cell malignancies)
indications.trial_name: Phase 1 POC at Thomas Jefferson University; pivotal Phase 2 / Phase 2-3 planned in COVID-19 patients with B-cell malignancies
indications.trial_design: Phase 1 single-arm POC infusion of HLA-A*02:01-matched CTLs in ambulatory high-risk adults with COVID-19; pivotal design pending FDA alignment
indications.trial_status: Phase 1 COMPLETED January 2023 (sponsored by Thomas Jefferson University, Tevogen collaborator); pivotal trial PLANNED — pending FDA feedback and financing
indications.lead_sponsor: Thomas Jefferson University (Phase 1); Tevogen Bio (planned pivotal)
key_milestones: Pivotal trial initiation pending FDA review of direct Phase 1 to pivotal pathway

indications.trial_name: Planned Phase 2 treatment trial in Long COVID sufferers (fatigue/cognitive subsets)
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 examining safety and efficacy of TVGN 489 in specific Long COVID phenotypes
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — Phase 2 in development per FY2025 10-K; not yet enrolling

excluded_preclinical: TVGN 920 — HPV-related cervical cancer (peptide candidate investigation)
TVGN 960 — HPV-related oropharyngeal cancer (peptide candidate investigation)
TVGN 601 — EBV-associated multiple sclerosis (EBV peptide testing underway)
TVGN 930 — EBV-associated lymphomas (EBV peptide testing underway)
TVGN 116 — chronic hepatitis B (early investigative work beginning)

summary_counts.note: TVGN 489 counted once as one asset spanning two indications

blockers: TVGNW is the warrant ticker (common stock = TVGN). Pivotal COVID-19 trial requires FDA alignment on direct Phase 1 to pivotal pathway and additional financing. Long COVID Phase 2 not yet on public registry.
